ctaText: Experience The Bluffs Ho Tram with AGS

faqs.q: What makes The Bluffs Ho Tram unique?
faqs.a: The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip is the only course in Vietnam — and one of a handful in all of Asia — built on clifftop terrain above the South China Sea. Greg Norman designed the layout to use the seaside ridgeline, with several holes playing directly along the cliff edge. The dramatic elevation changes and ocean exposure create conditions found nowhere else in Vietnamese golf.

faqs.q: Who designed The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip?
faqs.a: Greg Norman designed The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip — his most technically accomplished course in Southeast Asia and his personal favourite in the region. Norman's Shark Design team worked extensively with the natural clifftop topography rather than against it, resulting in a layout that feels sculpted from the landscape.

faqs.q: Where is Ho Tram and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Ho Tram is located on the southern Vietnamese coast approximately 2.5 hours by private car from Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC). AGS arranges private transfers from HCMC for all Bluffs clients. The Ho Tram Strip resort complex contains both The Bluffs course and several accommodation options.

faqs.q: What is the best time to play The Bluffs Ho Tram?
faqs.a: November through April is The Bluffs' prime season — Southern Vietnam's dry season brings consistent sunshine and minimal rainfall. The April–May shoulder period is also excellent. Avoid June–October when the Southwest Monsoon can affect conditions.

faqs.q: Can I stay at the Ho Tram Strip resort?
faqs.a: Yes — the Grand Ho Tram Strip resort is AGS's preferred on-site accommodation for The Bluffs. Alternatively, AGS can arrange a HCMC combination: city nights at the Park Hyatt Saigon with a day trip or overnight to The Bluffs via private transfer.

content:
Executive Summary:

  • The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip, designed by Greg Norman, is a 7,030-yard, par-71 clifftop course located 30-40 meters above the South China Sea in Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province, 2.5 hours from Ho Chi Minh City. Norman himself called it his finest design in Asia, a region where he has designed courses across 30 countries.
  • The course's back nine runs along a clifftop ridgeline, where prevailing easterly winds (15-25 knots during the November-April dry season) significantly impact play, particularly on the par-3 12th hole, which can play from 165 to 230 yards into the wind.
  • Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) rates The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip 9.3/10, considering it the finest course in Southern Vietnam. AGS typically pairs 2-3 nights in Ho Chi Minh City (including golf at Vietnam Golf and Country Club and Thu Duc) with an overnight stay at The Grand Ho Tram Strip for a morning round at The Bluffs.

The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram: 2026/27 Technical Scorecard & Logistics

Greg Norman played The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip for the first time from the back tees and called it the finest design he'd ever built in Asia. That tells you something. Norman has designed courses across 30 countries; he's built on ocean frontage in Australia, New Zealand, and Thailand. But the clifftop ridgeline at Ho Tram — 30 metres above the South China Sea, wind in from the east, nowhere to hide — apparently struck him differently.

After facilitating dozens of rounds there over several years, we understand why.

The Course

Location: Ho Tram Strip, Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province — 2.5 hours from Ho Chi Minh City
Designer: Greg Norman / Shark Design
Length: 7,030 yards (championship)
Par: 71
Terrain: Clifftop — 20–40m above South China Sea
Best Season: November–April

Clifftop Golf: What the Layout Does

The Bluffs uses a fundamental design principle rarely available to architects: the land itself provides dramatic context that other courses must create artificially. Norman runs the back nine along the clifftop ridgeline, where prevailing easterly winds — typically 15–25 knots during dry season — make distance judgement unusually challenging.

The par-3 12th is the course centrepiece: played from an elevated tee directly into the prevailing wind, with the East Sea visible from every part of the hole. In calm conditions it plays around 165 yards to a green perched on the cliff edge. Into the wind, it can play 230 yards with a long iron. Our caddie team at The Bluffs have developed a microwave-accurate read of the daily wind pattern across this hole.

How AGS Pairs The Bluffs with Ho Chi Minh City

The Bluffs is best experienced as part of a Southern Vietnam extension rather than a standalone trip. AGS typically pairs 2–3 nights in Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam Golf and Country Club, golf at Thu Duc, Park Hyatt Saigon accommodation) with an overnight at The Grand Ho Tram Strip resort for a Bluffs morning round. The 2.5-hour scenic coastal drive is part of the experience — private car, stop at Ba Ria market for breakfast, arrive in time for a warm-up and 7am tee time.

AGS rates The Bluffs Ho Tram Strip 9.3/10 — the finest course in Southern Vietnam by a significant margin. See the full course profile on our Bluffs Ho Tram course page or explore the Vietnam golf hub for the full national circuit.
